set -Eeuo pipefail
sudo -n -H /usr/bin/python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast, os, re, json
root=Path('/opt/telegram-robot-leads')
installed=(root/'.verified-source-commit').read_text().strip()
print('INSTALLED_SOURCE',installed)
print('ROOT_OWNER_UID',root.stat().st_uid,'EFFECTIVE_UID',os.geteuid())
targets=[
 ('scripts/safe_runtime.py',('load_approved_users','assigned_account','_add_one','_record_not_addable')),
 ('scripts/operation_policy.py',('empty_state','load_state','check_action','record_success')),
 ('scripts/organic_growth.py',('approve_pending_join_request',)),
]
for file,names in targets:
 p=root/file
 source=p.read_text()
 lines=source.splitlines()
 tree=ast.parse(source)
 nodes={n.name:n for n in tree.body if isinstance(n,(ast.FunctionDef,ast.AsyncFunctionDef))}
 print('SOURCE',file,'TOTAL_LINES',len(lines))
 for name in names:
  node=nodes.get(name)
  if not node:
   print('MISSING_FUNCTION',name)
   continue
  print('FUNCTION',name,'LINES',node.lineno,node.end_lineno)
  for i in range(node.lineno-1,min(node.end_lineno,len(lines))):
   text=lines[i]
   if len(text)>210:text=text[:210]
   print(str(i+1)+': '+text)
print('TESTS_WITH_DEDUP_CRITERIA')
testdir=root/'tests'
if testdir.is_dir():
 for p in sorted(testdir.glob('test_*.py')):
  data=p.read_text()
  checks=[(i,l.strip()[:180]) for i,l in enumerate(data.splitlines(),1) if re.search(r'dedup|duplicate|already.*added|approved_user_ids_done|pending_member_ids|permanent|across.*account|across.*group|once.*ever|never.*readd',l,re.I)]
  if checks:
   print('TEST',p.name,'MATCHES',len(checks))
   for item in checks[:16]:print('CHECK',*item)
print('OPERATION_STATE_SCHEMA_COUNTS')
p=Path('/var/lib/telegram-robot-leads/operation-state.json')
if p.is_file():
 obj=json.loads(p.read_text())
 for key in ('approved_users_done','approved_user_ids_done','pending_member_ids','pending_member_actions','approved_join_requests_done','joined_groups','pending_join_requests'):
  val=obj.get(key)
  print('STATE_COUNTER',key,len(val) if isinstance(val,dict) else 'MISSING')
print('READ_ONLY_GLOBAL_DEDUP_AUDIT_DONE')
PY
